purpose: Teach: 投げかけ/飼料/熟練/義務付け/ステンレス/預かり/行き過ぎ/混在

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新企画、若手に、問いを、投げかけて、考えさせろ、議論、活発化させろ、本当に、必要だ、社内に。
lines.en: We need to pose questions to the younger staff on this new initiative. Get them thinking. Activate real discussion in the company.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Deliberate pauses between clauses. Clear-eyed and expectant. The cadence of someone used to being heard and heeded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。畜産事業、飼料の調達、安定化、進めております、コスト管理、徹底中です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're advancing feed-procurement stabilization in livestock operations. Cost management is under strict control right now.
lines.style: Steady, report-like delivery. Respectful distance maintained. Each point crisp and itemized. Quiet confidence in the work being done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 熟練の技術者、若手に、技術伝承、徹底させろ、創業以来の財産、絶対、失わせるな、本当に大事だ。
lines.en: The skilled technicians must pass on their techniques to the younger people thoroughly. That knowledge is a founding asset. Don't lose it. It's absolutely vital.
lines.style: Firm, almost grave weight on 'absolutely vital.' Slow enough that each sentence lands. The voice of someone protecting something irreplaceable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。安全装備、社員に、義務付ける方針です、来期から、徹底中、ご了承ください、社長。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're implementing a new policy requiring safety equipment across all staff, starting next term. It's being thoroughly enforced.
lines.style: Formal, deferential. Report-tempo, no embellishment. Professional assurance — saying this is already in motion, not a question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、ステンレス素材、採用しろ、耐久性、本当に、重要だ、お客様の信頼、こだわれ。
lines.en: Adopt stainless steel for the new product line. Durability is critical. Focus on quality — that's what builds customer trust.
lines.style: Direct, almost conversational but weighted. 'Critical' lands with quiet emphasis. The instruction of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様からの預かり物、保管体制、見直しております、最新、安全対策、徹底中です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're reviewing our storage system for customer deposits. Latest safety protocols are in full implementation right now.
lines.style: Calm, procedural. Respectful formality. Each update delivered as though it's already solid ground beneath the company.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 宣伝、行き過ぎないように、品位、保て、当社の、品格、本当に、大事にしろ、絶対だぞ。
lines.en: Advertising must not overreach. Maintain dignity. Protect the company's character. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp, non-negotiable edge to the closing phrase. Measured through the middle. This is a line being drawn, gently but firmly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新旧の社員、混在する職場、活気、出ております、世代間交流、活発化中です、本当に、最近。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our mixed workforce of veteran and newer staff is showing real energy. Cross-generational exchange is very active these days.
lines.style: Warm uptick at 'real energy.' Appreciative rhythm. Closing on an upward note — this is good news being delivered with genuine warmth.
